t: A credit-card Linux computer with Wi-Fi 6 and a small AI engine.
steps: Buy the board from Ameridroid, Arace Tech, or Allnet China. Ameridroid listed the 6 GB model at about 139 US dollars.
Get a USB-C power adapter rated 10 to 25 W and a microSD card.
Download a Radxa Debian image from the Radxa docs.
Write the image to the microSD card and slide it into the board.
Connect a screen, a keyboard, and a network cable, then power on.
Install VS Code and run a short Python script that blinks an LED on the 40-pin header.
Try an RKNN toolkit example to test the AI engine.
meta: Open Board. From $60. A few stores.
